channel.title: The Drill Down: Jacksonville Jaguars
channel.description: Weekly NFL matchup scouting reports and win probabilities.

item.title: Week 11: Jaguars at Giants
item.description: Sun 11/22 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: JAX -6 · O/U 46.5 | Model NYG 37% vs. market 31% | Jacksonville has to cash its red-zone trips, because the Giants' defense allows touchdowns on 69% of them, the worst rate in the league. Malik Nabers draws 29% of the Giants' targets, and he runs into a Jacksonville pass defense ranked 4th. Our model also picks Jacksonville, at 63% to the market's 69%, and the passing matchup is its largest driver.

item.title: Week 10: Jaguars at Titans
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: JAX -10.5 · O/U 45.5 | Model TEN 21% vs. market 17% | Jacksonville's passing offense, ranked third in EPA per dropback at +0.29, meets a Tennessee defense that must limit explosives, which it allows on 8.5% of plays. Trevor Lawrence, a top-two quarterback, feeds Parker Washington, who draws 24% of targets against a Tennessee pass defense ranked 30th. Our model agrees with the market that Jacksonville is the favorite, a bit less bullish than the 83% price, with the passing matchup (6.2 points) doing most of the work.
